messages:
maya: Heads-up: Nimbus Cloud asked to co-host a launch week push. Scope: marketplace listing + benchmark blog + partner webinar + coordinated social. Need owners & a lightweight checklist.

raj: I can take marketplace listing and approvals. Please share final hero benchmarks and the legal-approved partner blurb.

alex: I9ll draft the benchmark blog + one-pager. Suggest we highlight: 8k seq streaming latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, and a short methodology section.

sophie: I9ll run webinar logistics and promo plan. Target date proposals: Apr 21 or Apr 28. Need speaker confirmations two weeks prior.

karen: For leads: recommend we tag leads with partner=nimbus and origin=marketplace_webinar. Routing flow: marketplace leads -> partner queue for qualification (48h SLA) -> GTM Sales if qualified. Thoughts?

maya: For the first program let9s use partner queue so Partnerships can approve intros. Keep SFDC mapping simple: Partner_Tags__c & Lead_Origin__c.

raj: Nimbus legal requires a co-branded asset checklist. I9ll send the asset template (logo sizes, brand colors, approved phrases).

alex: Benchmark details: running inference on 8k sequence batched at 4, compare against our baseline model on A100. Will document test harness and raw numbers. Expect results Fri.

sophie: Promo plan: 3 waves email (announce, reminder, day-of) + 2 LinkedIn posts + partner amplification. Budget ask for paid social: $1.2k. Also propose a shared registration page with Nimbus UTM.

maya: Owners checklist:
- Marketplace listing copy & assets: raj
- Bench blog + methodology: alex
- Webinar ops & registration: sophie
- Inbound lead tagging & routing rules: karen
- Social + launch post copy: maya

karen: Quick routing JSON for Eng/SFDC admin to implement:
```json
{
  "partner": "nimbus",
  "origin": "marketplace_webinar",
  "route": "partner-queue",
  "qualification_sla": "48h"
}
```
(Implement Partner_Tags__c <- partner; Lead_Origin__c <- origin; AssignmentRule = partner-queue)

maya: Good. Alex please flag any benchmark caveats in the doc (seq length skew, warmup steps). Sophie, lock webinar date by Mon so we can start ads. Raj, share Nimbus approvals timeline.

pm-bot: Reminder scheduled: submit co-brand assets to Legal by 2026-04-02 08:00 PT.

alex: Uploaded preliminary numbers and methodology to the bench doc. Noted that 16k runs are flakier; recommending we lead with 8k data and include 16k as appendix.

sophie: Confirmed: Nimbus PM is available Apr 21 morning PT. Locking the webinar for Apr 21 9am PT. I9ll create the registration page and shared calendar invite.

raj: Nimbus sent logo pack and partner blurb. I9ll draft marketplace listing and tag you for review, Maya.

maya: Thanks team. Please update the shared tracker and add ETA for any blocked items. We9ll aim to publish the benchmark blog and marketplace listing on Apr 20, webinar Apr 21, and a follow-up case study in May. Flag any risks now. :rocket:
